description: Cross-run partition-scoped mutex via Dagster event log. Scans recent ASSET_OBSERVATION events for partition_lock_acquired=<partition_key> newer than ttl_seconds; conflicts resolve per on_conflict (wait/skip/fail). Emits partition_lock_acquired on entry + partition_lock_released post-compute. TTL auto-expires stuck holders. Probabilistic — two runs within ~200ms could both acquire; adequate for backfill dedupe, not money transfers. Companion @partition_lock decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. On skip: metadata.partition_lock_skipped=true. Acquired/released observations bracket compute.

asset_name.description: Dagster asset name. Required when NOT using `wraps:` (inherited from inner in wraps mode).
asset_name.label: Asset Name

backend.label: Backend
backend.description: Lock backend: `event_log` (default, soft mutex via AssetObservation events — races on simultaneous acquire) OR `postgres` (hard mutex via `pg_try_advisory_lock`, requires a Postgres URL env var + `psycopg` or `psycopg2` installed).

postgres_url_env_var.label: Postgres Url Env Var
postgres_url_env_var.description: Env var name holding a Postgres URL. Required when `backend=postgres`. Uses `pg_try_advisory_lock` / `pg_advisory_unlock` keyed on a signed int64 derived from sha256(asset_key + partition_key). Lock auto-released on session end.

name: Partition Lock Asset
